newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Jefferson Union HSD, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN by the Jefferson Union High School District (the District''), that bids will be received by a representative of the District at the office of Dale Scott & Co., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, California, on

at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time for the purchase of not to exceed $6,000,000 principal amount of the bonds of the District designated the Jefferson Union High School District (County of San Mateo, California) General Obligation Bonds Election 1995, Series B,'' (the Bonds''). The Bonds will be issued under the provisions of a Resolution adopted by the Board of Trustees of the District on April 15, 1997 (the Resolution''), and pursuant to the laws of the State of California. The Bonds are more particularly described in the proposed form of the Resolution on file with the District (which is incorporated herein by reference) and copies thereof will be furnished to the bidder upon request. Further information, including copies of the preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and form of Bid Proposal, may be obtained from Dale Scott & Company, Inc. at 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, California 94104 (telephone: (415) 956-1030).
Clerk of the Board of Trustees
of the Jefferson Union High School District
